Mission Local reported that Alemany Farm was facing a $100,000–$150,000 budget gap after one-time city funding ran out. The story also described paused paid apprenticeships, reduced staff hours and a campaign to raise $200,000. It noted that about half of the farm’s previous-year funding came from city sources, and that HSA approved a grant extension through June 2026.
